why: Izquierdo & Lucchini Arteche's 'Transfer principles for Galois cohomology and Serre's conjecture II' (arXiv 2308.00903, published in Advances in Mathematics vol. 480, 2025) proves that Serre's conjecture II for characteristic 0 fields implies it for positive characteristic fields, a case-reduction result about this exact conjecture; however the arXiv preprint predates the snapshot (Aug 2023) and it is unclear whether the journal publication in 2025 constitutes new post-snapshot movement or just a later publication of pre-snapshot work.
